auxiliary_activity.activity: First interim evidence publication; LAN upload and hashing may affect concurrent latency. No further evidence upload planned during main batch.

notes: Semantic results use direct Codex judgements, never keyword or reference matching.
OCR exact-read diagnostics normalize Unicode, case and punctuation; they are not semantic accuracy.
UI labels can be legitimate commands; their translation is not automatically a false positive.
Post-scene OCR errors are separated because shutdown cancellation can raise them.
Both topic cues present checks verbatim normalized OCR only; a miss does not establish that no equivalent context was supplied.
